headline: Markets, trade, & the price of things
intro: Hi! I am Bryan, an Economics PhD student at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore. I'm interested in global markets such as why prices move, how trade flows shift, and how politics changes both.
intro_more: Before pursuing my PhD, I spent two years at S&P Global assessing movements in commodity prices

themes.title: Global political economy
themes.text: How governments and industrial policy reshape the markets that firms operate in
